concerns.text: T048 (compute averaging logic for Teacher Distribution) is listed as a separate task from T021 (persist raw logits) but lacks an explicit dependency marker. FR-003 and FR-014 require the Teacher Distribution to be the average of raw logits. If T048 runs before T021 completes, the artifact 'data/teacher_logits_raw.json' will be missing, causing a runtime failure. The 'Dependencies & Execution Order' section lists Phase 3 as a block but does not explicitly enforce T021 -> T048 ordering within the phase.

T006 (Power Analysis) depends on data statistics (T009/T015) per the 'Dependencies' section, yet T006 is placed in Phase 0 (Research) while T009/T015 are also in Phase 0. The text states 'T006 depends on T009/T015 data stats', but T015 (download) is in Phase 2 (US1). This creates a circular or impossible dependency: T006 needs stats from T015, but T015 is in a later phase. Power analysis (FR-013) must happen BEFORE data collection (T015), but the task order implies T015 must run first to get stats for T006.

T035 (generate HTML rater interface) and T047 (parse human scores) are listed, but there is no task defined to actually recruit or manage the '3 independent human raters' required by FR-015. Without a task to execute the human evaluation (or a clear dependency on an external manual step), T047 cannot produce the 'Human Evaluation Proxy Score' required for T036, T037, and T038. The flow is broken at the input to the analysis phase.

T017 description mentions 'detect and re-sample if identical to unselected rationales' but does not explicitly include the fallback 'exclude' logic required by the spec's Edge Cases section. While minor, this ambiguity could lead to an infinite loop if re-sampling fails, violating the 'Producer before Consumer' flow if the task hangs.
